notes.en: Foreign crimson{{efn|"Since magenta, an imported artificial color, also resembled {{translit|ja|Kara-kurenai}} (here also {{translit|ja|Kara}} means Korea; {{translit|ja|kurenai}} means red), people started to call the deep red formerly known as {{translit|ja|kara-ai}} by the new designation {{translit|ja|Kara-kurenai}} (here, however, {{translit|ja|"Kara"}} means China)."<ref name="summer kimono">{{cite book |last=Yumioka |first=Katsumi |date=2006 |title=着と日本の色・夏篇・夏着物で綴る日本の文様と伝統色 |trans-title=Summer Kimonos and the Colors of Japan・Kimono Collection of Katsumi Yumioka |language=ja,en |location=Tokyo |publisher=PIE Books |isbn=978-4894445314}}</ref>{{rp|37}}}}
notes.ja: 鮮やかな濃い紅色。名前は「韓紅花」とも書き韓から伝来した紅の意味、唐は後の当て字。
